title: ACP checkout, happy path (REST, delegated card token)
summary: An agent discovers the seller, creates and updates a checkout session, gets a vault token scoped by an allowance, completes the session and receives an order event.

steps.label: GET /.well-known/acp.json
steps.detail: Optional discovery with no authentication. The response lists protocol versions, transports (rest, mcp) and services. Payment handlers are not included.

failures.outcome: Agent falls back to an out-of-band configuration; discovery is optional.

steps.label: Ask to buy an item
steps.detail: The buyer chooses a product in the agent interface. Nothing in ACP records this request.

steps.label: POST /checkout_sessions
steps.detail: Create request with line_items, currency and capabilities, plus the bearer key, API-Version and a required Idempotency-Key.

steps.label: 201 session (not_ready_for_payment)
steps.detail: The merchant returns the authoritative session: line items, totals, fulfillment options, messages, links and its payment handlers.

steps.label: POST /checkout_sessions/{id} (update)
steps.detail: The agent sends the fulfillment details and the selected fulfillment option. The merchant recalculates tax and totals.

failures.outcome: 200 with a MessageError code out_of_stock; status stays not_ready_for_payment

steps.label: 200 session (ready_for_payment)
steps.detail: Full state again. The agent re-renders totals and messages and shows them to the buyer.

steps.label: Show total, buyer confirms
steps.detail: The buyer confirms the total in the agent interface. This confirmation is a product feature; ACP has no signed consent object.

steps.label: POST /agentic_commerce/delegate_payment
steps.detail: The agent sends the card and an allowance bound to this merchant, this session, a maximum of 330 minor units in usd, one use and an expiry.

steps.label: 201 vault token
steps.detail: The PSP stores the card and returns an opaque token id (vt_...). With Stripe this is a Shared Payment Token, a Stripe product.

steps.label: POST /checkout_sessions/{id}/complete
steps.detail: payment_data names the handler and carries the token as the credential.

steps.label: Charge the token
steps.detail: The merchant charges through its own PSP. The PSP accepts the token only inside the allowance. This call is outside ACP.

steps.label: 200 completed + order
steps.detail: The response must carry status completed and an order with id, checkout_session_id and permalink_url. The OpenAPI lists 200; OpenAI expects 201.

steps.label: Webhook order_create
steps.detail: Signed with Merchant-Signature (HMAC-SHA256). order_update events follow for shipping, refunds and other adjustments.
